text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Metering alert: midnight window emit delay + token-count divergence detected for 2026-03-16T00:00Z window. Probe job failed to write 00:00-00:15 batch. Auto-alerts firing.

oncall-anna: Ack. I'm taking this. Starting triage — tagging billing-ops and eng-sre.

eng-sre-raj: looking. runbook step1: check emitter logs and last-success. running:
```
kubectl logs deploy/metering-emitter -n prod --since=2h | grep "emit" | tail -n 50
```

billing-ops-mia: seeing spike in customer overage flags since 00:10 UTC. A few customers already hit auto-notify threshold. Holding off notifications if possible.

oncall-anna: Mia — please hold external alerts. We need to confirm counts before customers get billed. Mia: can you pause the notification lambda? if yes, how quickly?

billing-ops-mia: pausing now. `aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name billing-notify --env VAR=paused` --> queued, ETA ~40s. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre-raj: found error in emitter: `ERR: kafka commit timeout` around 00:02-00:12. looks like producer backlog + retry storm. Tail of logs:
```
[00:05:12] producer: write 0 failed: TimeoutError
[00:06:03] producer: retrying (retry=3)
[00:06:10] emitter: buffer overflow, dropping 1200 events
```

infra-tim: Cloud metrics show transient broker CPU spike + network retransmits in us-east-1 > 00:00-00:08. Possibly maintenance window hit a pool. I've opened ticket to cloud provider, but we should mitigate immediately.

oncall-anna: Immediate mitigation: switch meter ingestion to fallback S3 batch path for the midnight window; start backfill job to re-ingest dropped events. Raj, can you trigger s3-fallback for the affected window?

eng-sre-raj: triggering now. Command:
```
./ops/reconcile --source s3 --window "2026-03-16T00:00:00Z/2026-03-16T00:15:00Z" --dry-run
```
Dry-run shows ~1.2M tokens missing vs expected. Starting real run.

eng-sre-raj: real run started, PID 22451. ETA ~12m. Streaming log: backfill writing to metering.ingest topic.

cust-ops-sarah: which customers are at risk? will support get a list to triage possible calls?

billing-ops-mia: pulling list now. 8 customers crossed warn threshold; 2 crossed billable threshold. Exporting CSV -> uploading to secure drive.

product-zoe: note: can we delay billing window finalization until reconciliation completes? We have a scheduled finalize job at 01:00 UTC.

oncall-anna: Good point. I'll pause finalize job. `scaler-runbook pause finalize-metering-00` --> paused.

eng-sre-raj: backfill completed. Reconciler summary:
- expected tokens: 4,512,900
- observed tokens (pre-backfill): 3,312,740
- backfilled tokens: 1,201,860
- post-backfill total: 4,514,600 (slight +1700 diff due to duplicate suppression)

oncall-anna: Thanks. Mia — can you re-run billing validation locally against post-backfill snapshot and check for any orphaned overage flags?

billing-ops-mia: running validation queries now:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM meter_snapshot WHERE window='2026-03-16T00:00' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING tokens > warn_threshold;
```
Result: 8 warn -> 2 billable -> After reconciliation: 7 warn -> 1 billable. One customer reduced below billable by ~15k tokens.

cust-ops-sarah: sharing list with support. We'll prep templated messages but hold until billing final.

eng-sre-raj: root cause summary: Kafka broker momentary overload + emitter backpressure led to drop; recon path missed due to a bug in retry backoff that retried too fast and exhausted buffers. Filed PR to add exponential backoff + circuit breaker. PR: https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/572

infra-tim: provider confirmed transient network issue tied to maintenance throttling; they've applied mitigations. We're monitoring cluster for 2h.

oncall-anna: Postmortem plan: 1) Incident doc, 2) fix retry/backoff (Raj), 3) make notification system tolerant of transient emitter gaps (Mia/Product), 4) add SLO on emit latency and end-to-end counts (Product/Eng).

product-zoe: I'll coordinate on priority: product + billing + eng. Add to roadmap cycle 2.

billing-ops-mia: re-enabling notifications now. `aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name billing-notify --env VAR=active` -> done. We'll hold immediate sends for 15m to ensure no flapping.

oncall-anna: Closing incident channel in 30m unless new anomalies. Filing follow-up ticket: INC-2026-0316-MIDNIGHT-LAG.

incident-bot: Incident ACK updated: owner=oncall-anna, status=mitigated, severity=P1->P2, duration=00:28:40.

oncall-anna: Thanks everyone. Short postmortem draft incoming. Any objections to marking root cause as provider network + emitter retry bug?

eng-sre-raj: no objections.

billing-ops-mia: ack.

cust-ops-sarah: ack, prepping customer comms for those who saw billable flags.

product-zoe: ack. I'll slot follow-ups.

oncall-anna: closing thread in 20. :weight_lifter:
